user.title: Norwegian Maritime Tracker
user.description: Before continuing, create a free BarentsWatch account and AIS client on the BarentsWatch website (see the integration documentation for links).

credentials.title: BarentsWatch Credentials
credentials.description: Enter the Client ID and Client Secret for your BarentsWatch AIS client. The integration will test the credentials before continuing.

mode.title: Tracking Mode
mode.description: Choose how to define the Norwegian area you want to monitor.

data_description.tracking_mode: Radius: track vessels around a point. Bounding box: track vessels inside a rectangle.

radius.title: Tracking Area
radius.description: Drop a pin in Norwegian waters and adjust the radius.

data_description.location: Centre point and radius of the area to monitor.

box.title: Bounding Box Tracking Area
box.description: Enter the north/east/south/west boundaries of the Norwegian area to monitor.

options.title: Tracking Options
options.description: Choose how often to refresh live AIS data and which vessels to show.

data.exclude_anchored: Exclude Anchored Vessels from Live Map
data.exclude_moored: Exclude Moored Vessels from Live Map

data_description.update_interval: How often to poll Kystverket live AIS data. Minimum 5 seconds.
data_description.stale_timeout: A vessel not seen for this long will be removed.
data_description.filter_vessel_types: Only show vessels of the selected types. Leave empty to show all vessel types.
data_description.exclude_anchored: When enabled, vessels with 'At Anchor' status are removed from the live map and device tracker entities but still appear in the summary attributes.
data_description.exclude_moored: When enabled, vessels with 'Moored' status are removed from the live map and device tracker entities but still appear in the summary attributes.
data_description.create_area_zone: Draws the tracked area as a zone on the Home Assistant map. Because the zone is not passive, people located inside it and outside every smaller zone will report this zone as their location.
data_description.vessel_log: Appends every observation, with all AIS fields, to a daily file in config/marinetraffic_tracker/. A busy area can write tens of thousands of rows per day.
data_description.vessel_log_format: CSV opens directly in a spreadsheet. JSON Lines is easier to process in scripts.
data_description.vessel_log_retention_days: Delete log files older than this many days. Set to 0 to keep them forever.

error.south_gte_north: South latitude must be strictly less than north latitude.
error.west_gte_east: West longitude must be strictly less than east longitude.
error.barentswatch_client_id_required: A BarentsWatch client ID is required.
error.barentswatch_client_secret_required: A BarentsWatch client secret is required.
error.invalid_auth: Unable to authenticate with BarentsWatch. Check the Client ID and Client Secret.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to BarentsWatch right now. Try again later.
error.invalid_options: Please review the options and try again.

abort.already_configured: This tracking area is already configured.
